title: Reference carousel recipe catalog

source.method: Observed editor controls, selected-choice styling, timeline scrubbing, and rendered reference frames.

curation.note: Library curated from the 108 observed recipes to 43, removing duplicates and near-duplicates. Kept entries retain their original observed settings and evidence.

limitations: The site Copy Variant Values operation reports Copied, but the browser virtual clipboard returned no exported data. originalVariantExport is null for every template. Settings are independently observed UI controls, not fabricated raw reference JSON.

Geometry/motion descriptions are visual observations. Recreation models are explicitly inferred, not the original algorithms. Exact shader deformation, curve equations, random seeds, transformation order and unit conversions remain unknown.
Five paused samples per template do not establish continuous playback, exact curve shape, export fidelity, or pixel-perfect reproduction. No paid export, upload or implementation was performed.

animation.description: Motion / Action: 0.88s; Motion / Pause: 0.13s; Motion / Duration: 20s; Motion / Direction: Forward; Curves / Default: Natural; In/Out / In/Out enabled: False (disabled control); Material / Material enabled: False.

steps: Load ordered media and construct the recorded card count. Demo captures reuse nine supplied editor assets; use deterministic media cycling when count exceeds asset count.

Position centers on a planar ring or ellipse. Radial faces rotate with the path; Billboard faces remain upright. Ellipticity and Axis change the ring, while Motion Spin can keep that frame static as cards circulate.
Apply the complete qualified settings list. Preserve percent, degree, second and pixel suffixes; treat unitless Size/Gap/Diameter/Perspective as engine-native values requiring calibration.
Separate per-card transforms, group transforms and camera projection. Do not assume an XYZ rotation order or camera-distance/Zoom conversion without calibration.
Evaluate animation from absolute time, including local delays/stagger and pauses. Avoid accumulating transforms frame to frame.

Compare the same media/order, canvas ratio and measured phases against every reference image. Also inspect dense samples around transitions; five samples alone cannot prove exact easing or loop continuity.
unknowns: This is an observed session state, not a guaranteed untouched factory preset. The editor can retain or adjust counts/media during template application.
Engine equations, effective pixel dimensions, custom card aspect, inactive parameters and random seeds were not exported.
